title: Anatomy and biomechanics
learning_outcomes: Explain planes of motion in the context of anatomy and biomechanics.
Compare and distinguish joint anatomy in the context of anatomy and biomechanics.
Apply muscle leverage in the context of anatomy and biomechanics.
Evaluate and justify decisions about movement observation in the context of anatomy and biomechanics.

lessons.title: Planes of motion
lessons.outcome: Explain planes of motion in the context of anatomy and biomechanics.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving planes of motion; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to annotated movement map.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain planes of motion from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of planes of motion; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Joint anatomy
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish joint anatomy in the context of anatomy and biomechanics.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving joint anatomy; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to annotated movement map.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain joint anatomy from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of joint anatomy; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Muscle leverage
lessons.outcome: Apply muscle leverage in the context of anatomy and biomechanics.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving muscle leverage; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to annotated movement map.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain muscle leverage from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of muscle leverage; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Movement observation
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about movement observation in the context of anatomy and biomechanics.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving movement observation; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to annotated movement map.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain movement observation from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of movement observation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of planes of motion; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of joint anatomy; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of muscle leverage; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of movement observation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
